connector.name: Mintqa MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Mint - AI-powered QA that runs your app in a real browser on every PR.
connector.summary: Hosted at mintqa.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mintqa-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the adamgusky account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MINT_MCP_URL
env.description: Override the Mint MCP endpoint (default: https://mintqa.dev/mcp).
